 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Indiana Pacers (5-8) and Philadelphia 76ers (10-3) will square off in the NBA tonight. Tipoff is set for 1:00 p.m. EST from Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, Pa. The game will broadcast live on DAZN-IND.
 The 76ers are 7.5-point favorites on the spread (76ers -7.5), with the over/under set at 224.5 total points. The 76ers are -290 moneyline favorites to win outright, while the Pacers are listed as +230 underdogs to pull off the upset.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Let's get into my Pacers vs. 76ers predictions and NBA picks for Sunday, November 15.
 Pacers vs 76ers Prediction
 Pacers vs 76ers pick: Pacers +7.5 (-110) 
 My Pacers vs 76ers best bet is Indiana against the spread, with the best price currently available at FanDuel . Make sure to find the best odds by checking our live NBA odds page.
 Download the Action Network app now for more NBA picks and analysis! If you want more Action Network content, be sure to add us as a preferred source on Google . 
 Pacers vs 76ers Odds
 Pacers vs 76ers spread: Pacers +7.5 (-110), 76ers -7.5 (-110)
 Pacers vs 76ers over/under: 224.5 (-110o / -110u)
 Pacers vs 76ers moneyline: Pacers +230, 76ers -290
 Pacers vs 76ers NBA Preview
 A caveat here: the injury report for this game is a mess. Tyrese Haliburton is out for the Pacers . Of course, Sixers backup Ariel Hukporti, who suffered a torn Achilles, is out.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement But Joel Embiid is also listed as out for this game with injury maintenance on his foot. So is Adem Bona with a cervical spine sprain (which sounds extremely not fun). Philadelphia does not have a center. It's Tacko Fall. That's it. They have no other centers available on the roster.
 Indiana, though, has Andrew Nembhard and Aaron Nesmith listed as questionable for this game. What a disaster.
 So betting into this game is a mess. That said, I think there's value on the Pacers.
 Pacers vs 76ers Pick, Betting Analysis
 First off, the Pacers are the No.2 defense against pick-and-roll ball handlers this season. They are fundamentally sound in defending and keeping guards from getting to the rim or firing from three, funneling them into the mid-range.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Now, the Sixers are glad to do that; they're excellent mid-range shooters, but that's less Tyrese Maxey 's game, and more Jaylen Brown and Embiid's game, but of course, Embiid is out. These are also less efficient shots than Maxey's spray of attempts.
 Philly is the second-worst transition team in the league. Indiana really doesn't play as much in transition as we're used to, whether that's without Haliburton or just a different team this year.
 However, the Pacers are still hyper-efficient when they do, scoring at the second-highest per-possession rate. They'll get out and run, and the Sixers will let them.
 I make this game 7.1 based on my full model and only Sixers -6.1 based on in-season figures. I think Indiana hangs and might win this game outright.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Pick: Pacers +7.5 (-110, FanDuel )
